opening.argument: The presentation offers OneCoin as an investment opportunity while promising a guaranteed return of over 500%: “new investment business opportunity that pays in euros which guarantee of making over 500% profit on your investment.” It ties earnings to purchasing packages, token increases, and rising coin value, with priced packages and upgrades presented as investments. It further recruits viewers into a team by claiming they earn 10% from subsequent purchases. Finally, it directs viewers to sign up, upgrade an account, and provide their name, username, and email. Together, these are not merely general lessons about cryptocurrency; they are a coordinated invitation to invest, recruit, and submit personal details based on extraordinary profit claims.
